rational_certificates.meaning: Every inclusion follows from the proved analytic tail bound. The recurrence and endpoint arithmetic use Python integers and Fraction.

profile.plotted_values: Numerical evaluation of the first spectral term. The exact mathematical first term differs from the normalized exact derivative by at most the stated analytic spectral-tail bound. That bound excludes floating-point roundoff and 40-digit decimal serialization error.
